top_signals.title: Saudi Arabia and Asia Locked In Dispute Over 2027 Term Oil Deals
top_signals.summary: Asian refiners and Middle Eastern producers are currently negotiating the term supplies of crude oil for 2027, as usual. The unusual part is that the Iran war has crippled fixed-term supplies this year, and Middle Eastern exporters have resorted to increased spot sales to deliver crude oil to their most important export destination.  With days left to conclude negotiations on the 2027 term sales under fixed volumes, refiners in Asia and Saudi Arabia are in disagreement over whether this year’s spot sales should be counted into the 2026…

top_signals.title: U.K. Sanctions Cryptomus for RU Money Laundering
top_signals.summary: The United Kingdom has issued economic sanctions against Cryptomus, a chameleonic cryptocurrency platform that experts say serves as a major conduit for payments related to ransomware, narcotics, darknet markets, fraud and cybercrime services that are helping Russia circumvent existing financial restrictions.

top_signals.title: Oil-Rich Alberta Votes to Stay in Canada in Historic Referendum
top_signals.summary: Albertans have rejected a proposal to move toward a separation from Canada, according to early results of the referendum held on Monday, as voters gave the federal government a boost to national unity. Residents of Canada’s oil province have voted to remain in Canada, CBC News projects based on the early results with still more than half of the votes to be counted. top_signals.title: Mixed outlook for energy expenditures this winter
top_signals.summary: We expect energy expenditures this winter to vary because of diverging trends in energy prices among fuels and regional variation in forecast temperatures. We expect that lower prices for natural gas and propane will drive decreases in expenditures this year for the half of U.S. households heating with those fuels. Higher prices for electricity and heating oil drive increased expenditures for households heating with those fuels in our forecast.
